title: Out-of-Band Challenge Replay and Original Evidence Byte Integrity
documentary_controls: Receipt bytes and putative original capture bytes must be supplied and match separately declared SHA-256 digests
JSON receipt binds challenge nonce, enrollment ID, receipt ID, claimed custodian key fingerprint and capture digest
Claimed source, holder and challenge issuer root/operator/administrator ancestry must be pairwise distinct
A caller-supplied prior nonce set rejects replayed challenge nonces; external nonce-ledger authority is not established
Unverifiable signatures and original device origin remain explicitly NOT_PERFORMED rather than claimed as verified
Missing, corrupted or mismatched receipt/capture bytes fail closed; no automated recovery or physical ACT
All accepted results describe documentary byte consistency only and always report zero independently authenticated custodians
remaining_gaps: No actual remote receipt or original hardware capture was independently obtained or authenticated
SHA-256 matching bytes do not prove that the source produced the physical evidence claimed
No public-key signature verification or live independently hosted out-of-band source is performed in this Python gate
No externally authenticated immutable replay ledger or authenticated freshness/UTC evidence is available
GitHub and 0root.ai owned copies are one ancestry and cannot become multiple witnesses by mirroring
Rust build/test execution, GitHub Actions conclusion and live Pages runtime remain unverified
